## Key change

Describe the main change and the behavior it adds, fixes, or improves.

## Reason

Explain why this change was made and which problem it solves. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Screenshot/video result (before/after)

### Before

Attach a screenshot or video of the previous behavior.

### After

Attach a screenshot or video showing the result in the same scenario.

If there is no visible result, explain why and provide relevant verification output instead.

## Confirmation

Describe the testing steps, expected result, and actual result. Include the macOS version and app version/build used for behavior changes, or the content and links checked for documentation-only changes. Disclose any testing limitations.

- [ ] I confirm that I have tested the affected behavior and verified that it works properly, or verified the content and links for a documentation-only change.
